description: Extend the existing Channels-owned conversation identity contract, not Mattermost-specific code. Operation: normalize provider/config/channel/user identity at CommunicationBridge and :conversation_identity. Action reuse: extend existing CommunicationBridge APIs and Channels.Api event; no new Action/tool because this is boundary normalization, not an independently agent-callable operation. Contract: JSON-safe stable identity, email bridge callback precedence, BO compatibility, invalid/missing values fail closed. Tests first: generic Jido chat channels, different room/config/user, email preservation.
title: [zaq-354.1] Conversation identity contract
